## App Information

**App Name:** 
(Example: Spotify, ChatGPT, Notion)

**Play Store Link:** 
(Example: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.spotify.music)

**Package Name:** 
(Example: com.spotify.music)

To find the package name:
1. Open app in Play Store
2. Click "Share" → copy link
3. Look for `id=` parameter (e.g., `com.spotify.music`)

**Note:** Icon requests are prioritized by:
- Number of upvotes
- Popularity of the app  
- Whether other users also request it
- Difficulty of designing a clean monoline version
